industry.key: K. Professional, business and consumer services
industry.why: Neutral, carried unchanged by judgement; see component 1, Special topics, Topic 1 (Recruitment Services). Component 1 regime, 2-Oct-26 (rates-led late cycle, hiking path marked down for the first time this week, growth firm at the level and rolling at the margin, index calm with risk-off running beneath it through breadth, size and rate sensitivity, not through defensives; sources present 2026-W40): the industry's composite rank (66, from 20 on 3-Jul) is a relief rally in the artificial-intelligence-exposed labour-service names measured by a composite weighted to the last six months, with the twelve-month return still -6.94% against the index; the seven sectors are split (Recruitment D, Advertising C, Testing B, the rest C) and the sector rows carry the view. Relative strength C now, C prior. Counter-case: if the recruiters' rebound is the early-cycle hiring turn, this industry leads and C is late.

sector.key: K.1. Outsourced business services: facilities, security, catering, waste and support
sector.why: Neutral, carried unchanged, tested against three memos (input 8d). Teleperformance (Mixed), Brockhaus Technologies (Mixed) and Green Landscaping (Fights it) all turn on the Fragility axis (a disposal project in a cracked credit market, a EUR 120 million uncovered single case, a 3.4x-levered small cap with a leverage peak), none on the Sector's tilt, so the Fragility row carries that judgement and this row does not double it. Component 1 regime, 16-Oct-26 (a discount-rate shock with the first credit crack inside the artificial intelligence chain: United States core inflation re-accelerating on energy, the Fed and Bank of England hikes pulled forward, the US 10-year about 5.1%, the US joined the sell-off and Asia is in washout, defensives bid for four weeks in Europe, European breadth off its three-year lows but in the bottom quarter, the consumer forecast to weaken into winter; sources present 2026-W42): contracted, defensive services against labour cost and the first discretionary cut when corporate margins roll over. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-16 against 2026-08-14, not week on week: C now, C prior. Balanced; Neutral by judgement. Two MI Pool names, MITIE and Teleperformance.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No Swedish survey and no Riksbank reading reached the pack this week, so the condition for B (a confidence print at or above normal with the Riksbank on hold) could not be tested; the only Swedish data point is food retail volumes up 5.3% in September after a value-added tax cut (Danske, 18 Oct), which is a sector fact, not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Four live holdings are Swedish (Avanza 0.50%, Hexatronic 4.95%, Sdiptech 5.05%, Xvivo 5.05%, 15.55 points), judged in component 4 and in amendment 10. Relative strength is not graded by country.
